title: Basic English — Course 2, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 13

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. Where should students complete the form?
tasks.audioText: The college reception has changed its procedure for reporting lost property. Students should complete a short form at the front desk and describe the item clearly. Valuable items are kept in a locked cabinet. The office is open from eight thirty until four thirty on weekdays. Students will be contacted if an item matching their description is found.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. How are valuable items kept?
tasks.audioText: The college reception has changed its procedure for reporting lost property. Students should complete a short form at the front desk and describe the item clearly. Valuable items are kept in a locked cabinet. The office is open from eight thirty until four thirty on weekdays. Students will be contacted if an item matching their description is found.

tasks.prompt: When Irina could not find her student card, she checked the places she had visited that morning. She then reported the loss at reception and completed the required form. The receptionist explained how to request a replacement card and reminded her to keep the confirmation email. Irina received the new card two days later. Reading 1. What did Irina do before reporting the loss?
options: She asked the tutor to search for it
She requested a new card immediately
She checked the places she had visited
She asked the tutor to issue a temporary card.
How to block the college account
How to request a replacement card

tasks.prompt: If you ___ your student card, report it to reception.
Choose TWO useful steps when reporting a lost item.
options: Post another person's private details online
Give the place and approximate time it was lost

tasks.prompt: A formal request for a replacement document is an ___.
You have found a phone in a classroom. What should you do?
options: Hand it in to reception or a member of staff.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of solving everyday problems in a sensible order.
options: Check where you last had the item
Follow the instructions for a replacement
Report the loss to the correct office
correctOrder: Check where you last had the item
Report the loss to the correct office
Follow the instructions for a replacement

tasks.prompt: Write 60–80 words explaining how you would report a lost college item and what information you would provide.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: the response explains where/when the item was lost and identifies the item clearly (0–2); it states whom to contact and what useful identifying information to provide (0–2); the report is concise and understandable with appropriate grammar (0–2); lost-property/reporting vocabulary, spelling and punctuation are appropriate (0–2).
